verses.text: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sound the alarm on my holy mountain! Let everyone who lives in the land tremble, because the day of the LORD is coming. It is close at hand.

It is a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness. Like dawn spreading across the mountains, a large and mighty army comes. There has never been anything like it, and there will never be anything like it again for generations to come.
Fire burns in front of them, and flames blaze behind them. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden, but behind them it is a ruined wilderness. Nothing escapes them.
They look like horses, and they charge like war horses.
With a noise like chariots, they leap over the mountaintops. They sound like a crackling fire burning up dry stalks, like a mighty army lined up for battle.
At the sight of them, nations are in agony. Every face turns pale.
They charge like warriors. They climb walls like soldiers. Each one marches in line, never turning aside.
They do not push one another. Each one marches in his own path. They break through the defenses without breaking ranks.
They rush into the city. They run along the wall. They climb into the houses. They enter through the windows like thieves.
The earth shakes before them, and the sky trembles. The sun and the moon grow dark, and the stars stop shining.
The LORD shouts commands to his army. His troops are too many to count, and those who obey his command are mighty. The day of the LORD is great and very terrible. Who can survive it?
"Even now," says the LORD, "come back to me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning."

Tear your hearts, not just your clothes. Return to the LORD your God, because he is kind and merciful. He is slow to become angry and full of faithful love, and he is ready to hold back from bringing disaster.
Who knows? He may turn and change his mind and leave a blessing behind him, so that you can bring grain offerings and drink offerings to the LORD your God.
Blow the trumpet in Zion! Announce a holy fast. Call a special meeting.
Gather the people. Prepare the community to meet God. Bring together the old people. Gather the children, even the babies still nursing. Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her bedroom.

Let the priests, who serve the LORD, weep between the temple porch and the altar. Let them say, "LORD, spare your people. Do not let your own people be disgraced, a joke among the nations. Why should the people of other nations say, 'Where is their God?'"
Then the LORD showed his deep love for his land and took pity on his people.
The LORD answered his people, "I will send you grain, new wine, and olive oil, enough to satisfy you completely. I will never again make you a disgrace among the nations.

I will drive the army from the north far away from you. I will push it into a dry and empty land, with its front toward the Dead Sea and its back toward the Mediterranean Sea. Its stench will rise, and its smell will spread." He has done great things!
Do not be afraid, land. Be glad and rejoice, because the LORD has done great things!
Do not be afraid, wild animals, because the pastures in the wilderness are turning green. The trees are bearing fruit, and the fig tree and the vine are giving their full harvest.
Be glad, people of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God! He has given you the autumn rain as a sign of his goodness. He sends you plenty of rain, both the autumn and the spring rains, as before.
The threshing floors will be filled with grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and olive oil.
"I will pay you back for the years the swarming locusts ate, the great locusts, the young locusts, and the other locusts, my great army that I sent against you.
You will have plenty to eat until you are full, and you will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has done wonderful things for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
Then you will know that I am among the people of Israel, that I am the LORD your God, and that there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
"After that, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams, and your young men will see visions.
In those days I will pour out my Spirit even on servants, both men and women.
I will show wonders in the sky and on the earth: blood, fire, and clouds of smoke.
The sun will become dark, and the moon will turn red as blood, before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.

And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved. On Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be people who escape, as the LORD has said. They will be among the survivors whom the LORD calls.
